[Intro]
[Cadd9]
[Bm7]  [B7/D#]
[Em7]  [Ebm7]
[Dm7]  [G6]
[Cadd9]
[Bm7]  [B7/D#]
[Em7]OMAE WA MOU... [Ebm7]
[G6][Dm7]SHINDEIRU

[Verse 1]
[Cadd9]Utsumuita kono odeko ton-
[Bm7]ton tataita No [B7/D#]we kimi nano ka-
[Em7]na? Chigau no kana? Me we [Ebm7]ake-
[Dm7]tai no ni mada [G6]kowain da
[Cadd9]yuuyake tte nan da ka
[Bm7]samishii [B7/D#]Onegai,
[Em7]matte Mou [Ebm7]sugu
[Dm7]motto motto [G6]yobu kara

[Verse 2]
[Cadd9]Utsumuita kono odeko ton-
[Bm7]ton tataita No [B7/D#]we kimi nano ka-
[Em7]na? Chigau no kana? Me we [Ebm7]ake-
[Dm7]tai no ni mada [G6]kowain da
[Cadd9]yuuyake tte nan da ka
[Bm7]samishii [B7/D#]Onegai,
[Em7]matte Mou [Ebm7]sugu
[Dm7]motto motto [G6]yobu kara

[Verse 3]
[Cadd9]Atarimae mitai na ko-
[Bm7]toba nante [B7/D#]yamete yo
[Em7]datte [Ebm7]hoshii no,
[Dm7]Homo no [G6]kimochi dake
[Cadd9]mada, mada, Kodomo dat-
[Bm7]te iun desho [B7/D#]wakatteru
[Em7]no Kawaritai no [Ebm7]dakedo ne
[Dm7]sotto sotto [G6]oshiete
[Cadd9]Atarashii sekai no ka-
[Bm7]gi mawashite [B7/D#]Senaka wo
[Em7]dakishimetai, [Ebm7]nante ne
[Dm7]Chotto osanai [G6]tte shitteru

[Outro]
[Cadd9]

[Dm7]  [G6]
[Cadd9]
